request.prompt: Create exactly one isolated full-body Geth Colossus from original Mass Effect 1, using the attached final in-game screenshot as the controlling reference. Faithfully preserve this exact elevated upright neck, three-quarter angle, crouched four-legged stance, long curved silver-white armor plates with their blue night illumination, black underskeleton, four articulated legs and asymmetric visible foot shapes, hanging black cables, dark plate markings, and the single intensely blue-white circular optic. Keep the final game model's smooth head/optic structure: do not add any protruding barrel from the early preproduction guide render, no held weapon and no new armor details. Copy the visible proportions, cable routing and overlaps carefully, including the partly occluded rear leg. Keep the source's cool blue reflected lighting, restrained surface detail and original game-model shapes, without redesign or extra mechanical greebles. The complete head, all four feet, armor fins and cables must be within the canvas with 10 percent clear margin on every side. Maintain this pose and perspective so unseen sides do not need invention. Remove the night sky, terrain, wall and ground shadow. Transparent background with real alpha; no environment, platform, text, border, floor shadow or long horizontal lens flare. Preserve only a small contained blue bloom at the optic so the shape remains readable. Exactly one robot in one view, no sheet or collage.

notes: Capture originale datée2008; modèle final sans canon protubérant du rendu Prima.
Corps et quatre appuis observés, un appui arrière partiellement superposé; câbles visibles.
Lumière nocturne bleue et bloom conservés comme conditions de référence; matériau neutre non certifié.
